applicability: Binomial acceptance-sampling OC-curve probability of accepting a lot at a declared sample size, acceptance number and assumed defect rate
assumptions: defects occur independently within the lot at the assumed constant rate
the lot is effectively infinite relative to the sample (binomial approximation)
excluded: full producer/consumer risk curve across multiple defect rates
uncertainty: Standard textbook acceptance-sampling statistics; hand-verified before use (n=50,c=1,p=0.01 -> P=0.9106; n=50,c=1,p=0.05 -> P=0.2794).
limits_policy: An acceptance probability below the declared minimum at the assumed defect rate is flagged rather than accepted.
